card.name: Space before 18 in fluorine-18 tracer names
card.fires_on: The space or letter F just before the isotope number 18 in PET tracer names such as Fluorodopa F 18 or Piflufolastat F 18. It also fires weakly on a few section-start words after a heading.

modes.label: Isotope gap in F 18 names
modes.description: The space (or F or 1) between F and 18 in a radiotracer name at the start of a sentence.

modes.label: Other section starts
modes.description: Occasional first word or space after a heading or before a chemical name, outside tracer names.
